D015-D005_h001.question:
It's been over a year now, and honestly, I just feel… flat. There’s no other way to describe it. Things I used to love, like sketching new designs or even just listening to music, they just don't hit the same anymore. It’s like a color has been drained out of everything. My mind feels fuzzy, too. I find myself misplacing my tools constantly or forgetting what I was just about to say. It's frustrating when you rely on precision in my line of work. Sometimes, I just think about how much easier it would be if I wasn't around, you know? Not that I’d ever act on it, but the thought just… lingers.

And things have gotten weirder lately. I've started noticing strange things. Like, I'll be walking down the street, and it feels like people are talking about me, whispering things. Or I'll be in my studio, and I swear I can feel something crawling on my skin, even when there's nothing there. It's unsettling. It's all too much, really. It’s making it hard to even focus on getting clients in.
D015-D005_h001.options:
A. Persistent Depressive Disorder
    B. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
    C. Schizophrenia
    D. Anorexia Nervosa

D015-D005_h002.question:
"Doctor, thanks for seeing me. It’s been… a really rough year and a bit. I just can't shake this profound sadness, you know? Like a dark cloud just hanging over me. Nothing brings me joy anymore. Then there’s these other things. Sometimes I get this awful smell, like something rotting, that no one else seems to notice. It's so vivid. And I've been convinced for a while now that there's something seriously wrong inside me, like my organs are deteriorating. I know it sounds strange, but it feels so real, like a certainty. It makes going to work, and really, just functioning at all, incredibly difficult."

A. Persistent Depressive Disorder
    B. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
